input: Frame and hang the gallery wall in hallway

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing how many pieces and what types (photos, prints, mirrors, etc.) determines the volume of work, number of frames needed, and complexity of the arrangement.
Whether this is a solo project or involves others (a partner, family, interior designer) affects coordination, decision-making, and shared preferences on style.
The hallway's wall dimensions, wall material (drywall, plaster, brick), and lighting conditions directly impact what hanging hardware is needed and what layout is feasible.
Budget determines whether frames are bought new, sourced second-hand, or already owned, and whether professional help is an option.
The desired visual style (matching frames, eclectic mix, specific colour palette, symmetrical vs. organic layout) shapes every design and purchasing decision.
Whether frames and art are already purchased or still need to be sourced determines the very first action to take.
Knowing what 'done well' means — a cohesive curated look, perfectly level alignment, a specific mood — sets the quality bar and guides layout choices.

gold.taskTitle: Frame and hang gallery wall in hallway
gold.taskDescription: Plan and execute a gallery wall display in the hallway, including selecting frames, arranging a layout, and mounting everything on the wall.

questions.title: How many pieces do you plan to hang?
questions.description: The total number of frames or art pieces to be included in the gallery wall.

questions.title: Do you already own the frames and artwork?
questions.description: Whether frames and art are already on hand, partially purchased, or still need to be sourced — determines the immediate first step.

questions.title: What are the wall's approximate dimensions and material?
questions.description: Height, width, and wall surface type (drywall, plaster, brick) to determine layout feasibility and required hardware.

questions.title: What is your budget for frames, hardware, and supplies?
questions.description: Total spend available, which drives whether frames are bought new, sourced secondhand, or already owned.

questions.title: What visual style are you going for with this wall?
questions.description: The desired aesthetic — matching frames vs. eclectic mix, symmetrical grid vs. organic salon-style, colour palette — to guide layout and purchasing decisions.

questions.title: Are you doing this alone or with someone else?
questions.description: Whether this is a solo project or involves a partner, family member, or professional, affecting coordination and shared decision-making.

questions.title: What will make this gallery wall feel finished and successful to you?
questions.description: The personal definition of 'done well' — perfectly level alignment, a specific mood, a cohesive look — to set the quality bar for the project.
